summary: Cross-validate TaskManifest v1 time windows, exact origins and principals, ordered browser scope, writes and reader budgets; duplicate reader principal/peer pairs are refused.

schema.detail: Shared manifest validation only; no registry or storage changes.

compatibility.detail: The new manifest parser now checks cross-field semantics. Reader principal/peerHost pairs must be unique; empty readers remain valid. General text uses the explicit ECMAScript TrimString blank set and rejects Unicode Cc controls. No active route uses this parser.

recovery.detail: Revert the library addition; no persisted state is changed.
